core_problem_solved: To provide a Java library for advanced console input handling, including line editing, history, and tab completion, similar to a standard Unix shell.
era_and_niche: An older version and Maven coordinate for the JLine library, a key component for building interactive command-line tools in Java. This coordinate was used before the project moved to its own dedicated groupId.
reason_for_obsolescence: This specific Maven coordinate is **obsolete**. The JLine project moved to a new groupId and has been significantly updated. The modern and actively maintained successor is **`org.jline:jline`**. Any project using the `org.sonatype` version should migrate.
